add-column: Two constant text defaults take PostgreSQL's fast-default catalog path and the narrative language column is nullable without a default, so no table is rewritten; lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and each statement by 5s.
add-constraint: Both value CHECKs are added NOT VALID without scanning existing rows; validation runs after COMMIT releases the schema locks.
create-table-references: The two new tables reference organization, user, agent_skill_resources and contacts; the referenced tables are locked only to attach the foreign keys, under the 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE RLS apply only to the two tables this migration creates empty.
create-policy: Policies install the user-organization and organization-admin boundaries on the two tables this migration creates empty, without reading application rows.
